newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rally at close on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rally at close on foreign buying.

text.p: Thai stocks closed sharply higher on Wednesday as foreign investors snapped up cheaply-price shares, brokers said.

The SET index finished up 24.26 points or 2.64 percent at 943.27. Trading value was the highest in nearly one month with shares worth 5.65 billion baht changing hands. The SET-50 index rose 2.07 points to 71.58.
Advancers outpaced decliners 291 to 60 with 73 issues closing unchanged.
"It's bargain hunting mostly by foreigners. The rise appeared to be in line with other bourses in the region," said one broker at Wall Street Finance.
The finance sector was the most active and led the market rally by rising more than seven percent, brokers said.
Brokers said the easing concern about banks' and finance companies' non-performing loans granted to property sector also helped improve sentiment.
Finance One rose six baht to its daily ceiling limit of 66 baht. It topped the active list in terms of turnover with 304 million baht trade.
National Finance surged five to 51 and Phatra Thanakit was up 5.50 to 94.
Bangkok Bank gained two to 196 and Krung Thai Bank added 6.50 to 85.50.
